ttl.name: Fuel Suction Tube Assembly (w/ Pump & Gauge) (2AZ-FE)

item.ptxt: Do not disconnect the hose at the location shown in the illustration.
When replacing the fuel filter, replace it together with the fuel suction plate.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the fuel sender gauge connector.
Remove the 2 harness protectors from the wire harness.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the harness covering.

s2.ptxt: Release the lock shown in the illustration, and slide the fuel sender gauge to remove it.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Fuel Pump Assembly w/ Filter

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the fuel pump harness connector.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the harness covering.

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 2 claws.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the sub-tank and fuel filter assembly.

s2.ptxt: Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, pull out the jet pump, and remove the fuel filter and fuel pump from the sub-tank.

item.ptxt: Do not damage the sub-tank, fuel filter assembly and jet pump.
The O-ring between the jet pump and sub-tank fits tightly, so remove it slowly using a screwdriver.

s2.ptxt: Remove the O-ring from the jet pump.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, remove the fuel suction support No.1.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, disengage the 5 claws, and remove the fuel pump filter and fuel pump from the fuel filter.

atten3.ptxt: Do not damage the fuel suction filter and fuel pump filter.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the fuel pump harness connector.
Using a screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, remove the pressure regulator.

atten3.ptxt: The O-ring between the fuel filter and fuel pressure regulator fits tightly, so pull it out slowly.

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 O-rings from the fuel pressure regulator.
